# 容密 (Rongmi), June-July 1916: cipher groups as re-read by Brice Dudout on the JACAR police copies.
# The forms carry the digits in kanji numerals in a grid, read in columns right to left, top to bottom, sheet after sheet,
# cut into groups of four. One telegram per line: label, then its groups. The clear prefix 1369 1378 (= 容密) is left out.
# "?" = illegible digit. Sheets and dates: decryption.txt.
